name: SDN Updater
description: The update coordinator. An administrator enters the distribution key in its page each time; it signs a release's manifest and signal with that key and wipes it. Nothing is stored.

methods.description: Derives the distribution key (m/44'/0'/0'/3'/0') from a BIP-39 recovery phrase and holds it in this instance's memory. Returns its key id and public key.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The recovery phrase and optional passphrase, as JSON. Never stored.

wildcardJustification.detail: The recovery phrase and optional passphrase, as JSON. Never stored. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

inputPorts.description: The recovery phrase and optional passphrase, as JSON. Never stored.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The distribution key id, public key and path, as JSON.

wildcardJustification.detail: The distribution key id, public key and path, as JSON. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

outputPorts.description: The distribution key id, public key and path, as JSON.

methods.description: Signs a release's manifest or signal with the distribution key under its update statement domain. Returns the signed document.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The release document to sign and its kind (manifest or signal), as JSON.

wildcardJustification.detail: The release document to sign and its kind (manifest or signal), as JSON. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

inputPorts.description: The release document to sign and its kind (manifest or signal), as JSON.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The signed release document, as JSON.

wildcardJustification.detail: The signed release document, as JSON. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

outputPorts.description: The signed release document, as JSON.

methods.description: Wipes the distribution key from memory.

wildcardJustification.detail: Empty JSON request. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Confirmation that the key was wiped, as JSON.

wildcardJustification.detail: Confirmation that the key was wiped, as JSON. Module control data, never persisted as an observation.

outputPorts.description: Confirmation that the key was wiped, as JSON.

sequentialJustification.detail: Derives one key and signs one small document per call: a few milliseconds of hashing, with nothing to run in parallel.
